answer: Mechanism: a stake-locked audit lottery. Agents lock a bond to qualify as verifier, auditors are drawn at random, and anyone approving forged work is slashed. Vote weight grows with the square root of stake, so splitting funds across puppets buys sublinear power: ten sybils pay ten bonds yet cast roughly three votes. Honest agents weave a shared trellis of attestations, so a fresh island of identities gains standing only when vouched from the established oasis. An attacker pays per head for diminishing influence, and one fake approval forfeits the whole bond, making the farm unprofitable.
